headline: Zhipu AI's GLM hits 20.9% — a new all-time high
summary: Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash just claimed the largest single-model token share ever recorded at 20.9%, vaulting the provider to 24.7% overall. DeepSeek holds second at 21.6%, but the Chinese AI landscape is reshuffling fast: Tencent, OpenAI, and Xiaomi round out the top five, which together command 71.9% of the market. Four new models entered the rankings today, while Mistral AI's nemo and three others dropped out.
highlights: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-20260826 hits 20.9% token share — an all-time record for any single model
Zhipu AI surged 6.8 percentage points in a single day, now at 24.7% provider share
Top two providers (Zhipu AI + DeepSeek) control 46.3% of the market
Four debuts: Anthropic's claude-4.6-sonnet, Meta's muse-spark-1.3, OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-pro, and Anthropic's claude-4.8-opus
Mistral AI's nemo, Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5-pro, InclusionAI's ling-3.0-flash-sante, and Qwen's qwen3.8-max all exited the top 51
